title: Amazon Locker: best-fit parcel hub
summary: Match incoming parcels to the smallest available locker by capacity size. Issue a single-use pickup code to unlock and free the compartment for future reuse.
code: # Assign packages to the best-fitting available locker and release on pickup code.
if cap >= parcel_size and locker_id not in self.occupied:
triggers: assign resource with size constraints to incoming requests using best-fit policy
issue and redeem temporary verification codes to release allocated slots
prompts: Design a self-service parcel locker station where packages are placed into the smallest compartment that fits, and customers retrieve them with an SMS code.
A gym assigns electronic lockers according to bag size, releasing the locker immediately once the member scans their digital key.
invariant: Each occupied locker holds at most one parcel with capacity >= parcel_size, and a pickup code maps to exactly one occupied locker until redeemed.
mantra: Sort by size, claim the smallest fit, release on redemption.
pitfalls: Without pre-sorting lockers by size, a small parcel can occupy a large locker and starve subsequent oversized parcels.
Failing to remove the locker from occupied on pickup leaks slots and exhausts capacity.
Allowing reuse of a redeemed pickup code compromises customer privacy and security.
